title: Assayers: independent, their number set by proportionality
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0019 no longer matches the current design.
decision: Judgment is made by independent assayers, on another model family than the builders where one is available (0146); a small cut has one, a larger or riskier one two. Where two disagree, the disagreement goes to the architect as a meaning question.
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
